# PROVENANCE — data/raw/

`data/raw/` is **immutable**. Never write to it, never edit in place. Every
downstream file must be regenerable from `data/raw/` + `src/` + `configs/`.
(CLAUDE.md §7.4)

One row per downloaded file. Fill in at download time, not afterwards.
